```{r}
shape_order <- c("top_peak_uniform", "top_heavy", "uniform", "symmetric",

# --- CHEMINS (A VÉRIFIER) ---
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-1-theoretical
#| fig-cap: "Figure 1 (Panneau) : Les 8 archétypes théoriques de distribution verticale du feuillage (LAD) utilisés dans le plan d'expérience."

# 1. Définition des Fonctions Mathématiques (Les "Recettes" de tes profils)
# Ces paramètres doivent correspondre exactement à ceux utilisés pour générer tes netcdf
get_theo_profile <- function(z, shape_name) {
  if (shape_name == "Uniform") {
    return(rep(1, length(z)))
  } else if (shape_name == "Top-Heavy") {
    return(dbeta(z, 7, 3))
  } else if (shape_name == "Bottom-Heavy") {
    return(dbeta(z, 2, 8))
  } else if (shape_name == "Symmetric") {
    return(dbeta(z, 5, 5))
  } else if (shape_name == "High-Symmetric") {
    return(dbeta(z, 7, 5))
  } else if (shape_name == "Top-Bottom (Bimodal)") {
    # Somme de deux betas pour les deux pics
    return(dbeta(z, 4, 20) + dbeta(z, 20, 4) + 2)
  } else if (shape_name == "Top-Peak") {
    # Pic très haut + base constante
    return(dbeta(z, 8, 2) + 1) 
  } else if (shape_name == "Extreme-Bottom") {
    return(dbeta(z, 1.1, 15))
  } else if (shape_name == "Low-Symmetric") {
    return(dbeta(z, 3, 5))
  } else {
    return(rep(0, length(z)))
  }
}

# 2. Génération des données pour le plot
z_seq <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 100) # Haute résolution
shapes_list <- c("Top-Peak", "Top-Heavy", "Uniform", "High-Symmetric", "Symmetric", 
                 "Top-Bottom (Bimodal)", "Low-Symmetric", "Bottom-Heavy", "Extreme-Bottom")

df_theo_profiles <- map_dfr(shapes_list, function(s) {
  lad <- get_theo_profile(z_seq, s)
  # Normalisation : On veut que l'aire sous la courbe soit visuellement comparable
  # (Densité Relative)
  lad_rel <- lad / mean(lad) 
  
  data.frame(
    Z_Rel = z_seq,
    LAD_Rel = lad_rel,
    Shape = factor(s, levels = shapes_list) # Ordonné du haut vers le bas
  )
})

# 3. Création du Graphique
p_theo <- ggplot(df_theo_profiles, aes(x = LAD_Rel, y = Z_Rel, color = Shape)) +
  # L'aire remplie (plus joli pour un profil)
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = LAD_Rel, fill = Shape), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
  # La ligne de contour
  geom_path(size = 1.2) +
  
  # Facetting pour avoir les 8 boîtes
  facet_wrap(~Shape, ncol = 3) +
  
  # Esthétique
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("Sol", "0.5H", "Haut")) +
  # scale_x_continuous(breaks = NULL) + # On enlève les chiffres de l'axe X (c'est du relatif)
  # +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 5, 10)) +
  
  labs(title = "Profils Verticaux Théoriques (MuSICA)",
       x = "Densité Foliaire Relative",
       y = "Hauteur Relative (z/H)") +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 11))

# Affichage
p_theo
```

```{r}
#| label: kmeans-analysis
#| message: false

# A. PRÉPARATION DES DÉCILES (Approche Relative "Shape")
# -----------------------------------------------------
df_deciles <- df_lad_long %>%
  group_by(id_plot) %>%
  mutate(
    H_canopy = max(z[lad > 1e-7], na.rm = TRUE),
    z_rel = (z - min(z)) / (max(z) - min(z)), # Hauteur relative 0-1
    lad_rel = lad / sum(lad)                  # Densité relative (Somme=1)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Decile = cut(z_rel, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1), labels = 1:10, include.lowest = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  group_by(id_plot, Decile) %>%
  summarise(LAD_Prop = sum(lad_rel), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(id_plot, Decile, fill = list(LAD_Prop = 0)) %>%
  group_by(id_plot) %>%
  mutate(LAD_Prop = LAD_Prop / sum(LAD_Prop)) %>% # Renormalisation finale
  ungroup()

# Matrice pour K-Means
df_matrix <- df_deciles %>%
  select(id_plot, Decile, LAD_Prop) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Decile, values_from = LAD_Prop, names_prefix = "D") %>%
  column_to_rownames("id_plot")

# B. K-MEANS (k=5 pour comparer aux archétypes)
# -----------------------------------------------------
set.seed(42)
k_final <- 5
km_res <- kmeans(df_matrix, centers = k_final, nstart = 50)

df_clusters <- data.frame(
  id_plot = names(km_res$cluster),
  Cluster_Kmeans = as.factor(km_res$cluster)
)

# Visualisation des Profils Moyens par Cluster
cluster_centers <- df_deciles %>%
  left_join(df_clusters, by = "id_plot") %>%
  group_by(Cluster_Kmeans, Decile) %>%
  summarise(Mean_LAD = mean(LAD_Prop), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Decile_Num = as.numeric(Decile))

# On garde ce dataframe pour la Figure 2
```

```{r}
#| label: pearson-matching

get_best_match <- function(real_z, real_lad) {
  # Normalisation
  h_max <- max(real_z)
  if(h_max == 0 || sum(real_lad) == 0) return(data.frame(Best_Shape="Unknown", Score=0))
  
  rel_z <- real_z / h_max
  rel_lad <- real_lad / sum(real_lad)
  
  # Interpolation
  grid_z <- seq(0, 1, length.out=100)
  prof_interp <- approx(rel_z, rel_lad, xout=grid_z, rule=2)$y 
  prof_interp[is.na(prof_interp)] <- 0
  
  # Bibliothèque de Formes Théoriques
  shapes_lib <- list(
    "uniform"          = rep(1, 100),
    "top_heavy"        = dbeta(grid_z, 7, 3),
    "bottom_heavy"     = dbeta(grid_z, 2, 8),
    "high-symmetric"   = dbeta(grid_z, 7, 5),
    "symmetric"        = dbeta(grid_z, 5, 5),
    "top_bottom_heavy" = dbeta(grid_z, 4, 20) + dbeta(grid_z, 20, 4) + 2,
    "top_peak_uniform" = dbeta(grid_z, 8, 2) + 1,
    "extreme_bottom"   = dbeta(grid_z, 1.1, 15),
    "low_symmetric"    = dbeta(grid_z, 3, 5)
  )
  
  # Corrélation
  scores <- sapply(shapes_lib, function(s) cor(prof_interp, s))
  best <- names(scores)[which.max(scores)]
  
  return(data.frame(Best_Shape = best, Score = max(scores, na.rm=TRUE)))
}

# Application
plot_shapes_theory <- df_lad_long %>%
  group_by(id_plot) %>%
  summarise(Match = list(get_best_match(z, lad)), .groups="drop") %>%
  unnest(Match)

# FUSION FINALE DES CARACTÉRISTIQUES PLOTS
df_plots_final <- df_metrics %>%
  left_join(df_clusters, by="id_plot") %>%       # Le Cluster K-means (Data-Driven)
  left_join(plot_shapes_theory, by="id_plot")     # Le Matching Théorique (Theory-Driven)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-netcdf-sims
#| cache: false

cache_file <- "data_musica_final_cache.rds"

if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  message("--> Chargement rapide depuis le cache RDS...")
  list_data <- readRDS(cache_file)
  df_sensi_hourly <- list_data$sensi
  df_valid_hourly <- list_data$valid
  df_macro_hourly <- list_data$macro
  
} else {
  message("--> Lecture des NetCDFs (Mode Robust)...")
  
  # --- A. MACROCLIMAT (IGN) ---
  # (Code inchangé car il fonctionne généralement bien si le fichier est là)
  ign <- read.table(ign_file, sep = ";", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fileEncoding = "ISO-8859-1")
  df_macro_hourly <- data.frame()
  for (d in date_seq) {
    tmp <- ign %>%
      filter(Date == format(as.Date(d), "%d/%m/%Y"), Code.placette == "CHS 41") %>%
      mutate(time = as.POSIXct(paste(Date, sprintf("%04d", Heure..TU.)), format = "%d/%m/%Y %H%M", tz = "UTC")) %>%
      rename(Tair_macro = Température.instantanée...C.) %>%
      select(time, Tair_macro)
    df_macro_hourly <- bind_rows(df_macro_hourly, tmp)
  }

  # --- B. SIMULATIONS FACTORIELLES (SENSITIVITY) ---
  h_vec <- c(10, 20, 30, 40)
  c_vec <- c(0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1) 
  l_vec <- 1:8
  s_vec <- shape_order
  
  df_list <- list()
  counter <- 0
  
  message("Démarrage boucle Sensitivity...")
  
  for(h in h_vec) {
    for(s in s_vec) {
      for(c in c_vec) {
        for(l in l_vec) {
          
          nc_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("height_", h, "m"), s, 
                               paste0("clump_", c), paste0("lai_", l), 
                               "musica_out_ERA5_synthetic.nc")
          
          if(file.exists(nc_path)) {
            # 1. Ouverture explicite
            nc <- try(nc_open(nc_path), silent = FALSE) # On veut voir l'erreur
            
            if(!inherits(nc, "try-error")) {
              # 2. Extraction avec l'objet nc ouvert
              raw_data <- try(get_variable(nc, "Tair_z"), silent = FALSE)
              nc_close(nc) # Fermeture immédiate
              
              if(!inherits(raw_data, "try-error") && !is.null(raw_data)) {
                tmp_df <- raw_data %>%
                  filter(nair == 1) %>% 
                  mutate(Tair_micro = Tair_z - 273.15) %>%
                  filter(as.Date(time) %in% date_seq) %>%
                  mutate(time = time - hours(2)) %>%
                  mutate(time = floor_date(time, "hour")) %>%
                  mutate(time = force_tz(time, "UTC")) %>%
                  group_by(time) %>%
                  summarise(Tair_micro = mean(Tair_micro, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
                  mutate(Height=h, Shape=s, Clump=c, LAI=l)
                
                counter <- counter + 1
                df_list[[counter]] <- tmp_df
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    # Petit indicateur de progrès
    print(paste("Hauteur", h, "traitée. Simulations cumulées :", counter))
  }
  
  if(length(df_list) > 0) {
    df_sensi_hourly <- bind_rows(df_list)
  } else {
    warning("ATTENTION: Aucune simulation de sensibilité chargée !")
    df_sensi_hourly <- data.frame()
  }
  
  # --- C. SIMULATIONS VALIDATION (PROFILS REELS) ---
  message("Démarrage boucle Validation...")
  files_valid <- list.files(valid_dir, pattern = "*.nc", full.names = TRUE)
  
  if(length(files_valid) == 0) warning(paste("Aucun fichier trouvé dans", valid_dir))
  
  df_valid_list <- list()
  
  for(f in files_valid) {
    # Extraction ID (Caractère)
    pid <- str_extract(basename(f), "(?<=pt_).+(?=\\.nc)")
    
    # 1. Ouverture explicite
    nc <- try(nc_open(f), silent = FALSE)
    
    if(!inherits(nc, "try-error")) {
      # 2. Extraction
      raw_data <- try(get_variable(nc, "Tair_z"), silent = FALSE)
      nc_close(nc)
      
      if(!inherits(raw_data, "try-error") && !is.null(raw_data)) {
        tmp <- raw_data %>%
          filter(nair == 1) %>%
          mutate(Tair_sim = Tair_z - 273.15) %>%
          filter(as.Date(time) %in% date_seq) %>%
          mutate(time = time - hours(2)) %>% 
          mutate(time = floor_date(time, "hour")) %>%
          mutate(time = force_tz(time, "UTC")) %>%
          group_by(time) %>%
          summarise(Tair_sim = mean(Tair_sim, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
          mutate(id_plot = pid)
        
        df_valid_list[[length(df_valid_list)+1]] <- tmp
      }
    }
  }
  
  if(length(df_valid_list) > 0) {
    df_valid_hourly <- bind_rows(df_valid_list) %>%
    filter(!id_plot %in% ids_to_remove)
  } else {
    warning("ATTENTION: Aucune simulation de validation chargée !")
    df_valid_hourly <- data.frame()
  }
  
  # Sauvegarde si on a des données
  if(nrow(df_sensi_hourly) > 0) {
    saveRDS(list(sensi=df_sensi_hourly, valid=df_valid_hourly, macro=df_macro_hourly), cache_file)
    message("Cache sauvegardé.")
  }
}
```

```{r}
# 1. Dataset Physique (Sensibilité)
df_physic <- df_sensi_hourly %>%
  inner_join(df_macro_hourly, by="time") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(time)) %>%
  group_by(Height, Shape, Clump, LAI, date) %>%
  summarise(
    T_Macro_Max = max(Tair_macro),
    T_Micro_Max = max(Tair_micro),
    T_Macro_Min = min(Tair_macro),
    T_Micro_Min = min(Tair_micro),
    Delta_Tmax  = T_Micro_Max - T_Macro_Max,
    Delta_Tmin  = T_Micro_Min - T_Macro_Min,
    log_slope   = log(coef(lm(Tair_micro ~ Tair_macro))[2]),
    .groups     = "drop"
  )

# 2. Dataset Validation (Obs vs Sim)
df_hobo <- read.csv(hobo_file) %>%
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct(datetime, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")) %>%
  filter(position_sensor == "a", as.Date(datetime) %in% date_seq) %>%
  group_by(id_plot, time = floor_date(datetime, "hour")) %>%
  summarise(Tair_obs = mean(t_hobo, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

df_val_final <- df_hobo %>%
  inner_join(df_valid_hourly, by=c("id_plot", "time")) %>%
  inner_join(df_macro_hourly, by="time") %>%
  left_join(df_plots_final, by="id_plot") %>% # Ajout Clusters & Shapes
  mutate(Error = Tair_sim - Tair_obs)
```

```{r}
#| label: gamm-model-bam-scat
#| message: false

# Préparation des données pour BAM
df_stats <- df_physic %>%
  mutate(
    LAI_Scaled = scale(LAI),
    Clump_Scaled = scale(Clump),
    Height_Scaled = scale(Height),
    Shape = factor(Shape, levels = shape_order),
    date_factor = as.factor(date) # Requis pour s(..., bs='re') optimisé
  )

# --- MODÈLES GAMM (BAM + SCAT) ---

# 1. TMAX (Jour)
gam_tmax <- bam(Delta_Tmax ~ s(LAI_Scaled, k=5) + Shape + Clump_Scaled + Height_Scaled + s(date_factor, bs="re"), 
                data = df_stats, 
                family = scat(),  # Famille Scaled-t (Robuste aux queues lourdes)
                method = "fREML", 
                discrete = TRUE)  # Optimisation vitesse pour gros datasets
gam.check(gam_tmax)

# 2. TMIN (Nuit)
gam_tmin <- bam(Delta_Tmin ~ s(LAI_Scaled, k=5) + Shape + Clump_Scaled + Height_Scaled + s(date_factor, bs="re"), 
                data = df_stats, 
                family = scat(),
                method = "fREML", 
                discrete = TRUE)

# 3. PENTE
gam_slope <- bam(log_slope ~ s(LAI_Scaled, k=5) + Shape + Clump_Scaled + Height_Scaled + s(date_factor, bs="re"), 
                 data = df_stats, 
                 family = scat(),
                 method = "fREML", 
                 discrete = TRUE)

# 4. MAX MICRO
gam_max_micro <- bam(T_Micro_Max ~ s(LAI_Scaled, k=5) + Shape + Clump_Scaled + Height_Scaled + s(date_factor, bs="re"), 
                 data = df_stats, 
                 family = scat(),
                 method = "fREML", 
                 discrete = TRUE)

# 5. MIN MICRO (Risque de Gel)
gam_min_micro <- bam(T_Micro_Min ~ s(LAI_Scaled, k=5) + Shape + Clump_Scaled + Height_Scaled + s(date_factor, bs="re"), 
                     data = df_stats, 
                     family = scat(),
                     method = "fREML", 
                     discrete = TRUE)

# Diagnostic visuel (optionnel)
# par(mfrow=c(2,2)); gam.check(gam_tmax)
```

```{r}
# Préparation Panneau B : Profils Moyens (Données issues de l'étape K-Means)
# Assure-toi que 'cluster_centers' est disponible depuis l'étape 1.2
p_profiles <- ggplot(cluster_centers, aes(x = Mean_LAD, y = Decile_Num, color = Cluster_Kmeans)) +
  geom_path(size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:10, name = "Hauteur Relative (Décile)") +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Densité Relative (LAD)") +
  facet_wrap(~Cluster_Kmeans, nrow=1) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(subtitle = "B. Profils Moyens (K-Means)")

# Préparation Panneau C : Histogramme de Fréquence
freq_clusters <- df_clusters %>%
  count(Cluster_Kmeans) %>%
  mutate(Freq = n / sum(n))

p_hist <- ggplot(freq_clusters, aes(x = Cluster_Kmeans, y = Freq, fill = Cluster_Kmeans)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Freq, accuracy=1)), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(subtitle = "C. Fréquence des Archétypes", x = "Cluster", y = "Fréquence") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Assemblage
p_profiles / p_hist + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-3-composite
#| fig-cap: "Hiérarchie des performances thermiques : Physique (A) et Statistique (B)."

# A. Prédictions
pred_curves <- ggpredict(gam_tmax, terms = c("LAI_Scaled [all]", "Shape")) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(LAI_Real = (x * sd(df_physic$LAI)) + mean(df_physic$LAI))

p_a <- ggplot(pred_curves, aes(x = LAI_Real, y = predicted, color = group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(title = "A. Saturation (Physique)", x = "LAI", y = "Refroidissement (°C)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# B. Coefficients
stats_shape <- tidy(gam_tmax, parametric = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(grepl("Shape", term)) %>%
  mutate(term = gsub("Shape", "", term))

p_b <- ggplot(stats_shape, aes(x = estimate, y = reorder(term, estimate), color = term)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(title = "B. Impact (Statistique)", x = "Est. GAM", y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_a + p_b + plot_layout(widths = c(1.5, 1))
```

```{r}
df_tradeoff <- df_physic %>%
  # filter(LAI >= 4) %>%
  group_by(Shape) %>%
  summarise(
    Summer = mean(Delta_Tmax),
    Winter = mean(Delta_Tmin),
    Stability = 1/abs(cov(Delta_Tmax, T_Macro_Max)) # Proxy Stabilité
  )

ggplot(df_tradeoff, aes(x = Summer, y = Winter)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = mean(df_tradeoff$Summer), 
           ymin = mean(df_tradeoff$Winter), ymax = Inf, fill = "green", alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype="dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(color = Shape, size = Stability), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Shape), fontface="bold", box.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  scale_size(range = c(3, 10)) +
  labs(title = "Figure 5 : Compromis Canicule vs Gel",
       x = "Refroidissement Été (Delta Tmax)", 
       y = "Protection Hiver (Delta Tmin)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-s1-composite-pearson
#| fig-cap: "Figure S1 : Validation du Matching Structurel. (A) Superposition des profils (Noir: Réel / Rouge: Théorique). (B) Matrice de Corrélation Pearson (Plus c'est clair/jaune, meilleur est le match)."
#| fig-height: 10

# A. Récupération des données réelles
df_s1_real <- cluster_centers %>%
  rename(LAD = Mean_LAD, Z = Decile_Num) %>%
  mutate(Z = Z/10) 

# B. Librairie de formes (Fonction unique)
# Note : Pour Pearson, la normalisation (sum=1) n'est pas strictement nécessaire 
# mathématiquement, mais on la garde pour la cohérence des plots.
get_shapes_lib <- function(grid_z) {
  list(
    "uniform"          = rep(1, length(grid_z)), # SD = 0 -> Pearson sera NA
    "top_heavy"        = dbeta(grid_z, 8, 2.5) + 2,
    "bottom_heavy"     = dbeta(grid_z, 2.5, 8),
    "symmetric"        = dbeta(grid_z, 5, 5),
    "top_bottom_heavy" = dbeta(grid_z, 4, 20) + dbeta(grid_z, 20, 5) + 2,
    "top_peak_uniform" = dbeta(grid_z, 15, 2) + 2,
    "extreme_bottom"   = dbeta(grid_z, 1.2, 15) + 0.05,
    "low_symmetric"    = dbeta(grid_z, 3, 5)
  )
}

# C. Fonction de calcul des scores (PEARSON R)
get_all_pearson <- function(lad_vec) {
  grid_z <- seq(0.1, 1, 0.1)
  shapes <- get_shapes_lib(grid_z)
  
  # Calcul de corrélation
  scores <- sapply(shapes, function(s) cor(lad_vec, s))
  
  # CORRECTION CRITIQUE : Uniforme renvoie souvent NA (car écart-type nul)
  # On remplace NA par 0 pour ne pas casser le code.
  # Cela signifie : "Si c'est plat, on considère qu'il n'y a pas de corrélation de forme"
  scores[is.na(scores)] <- 0
  
  return(scores)
}

# Calcul de TOUS les scores pour chaque cluster
scores_df <- df_s1_real %>%
  group_by(Cluster_Kmeans) %>%
  summarise(Scores = list(get_all_pearson(LAD)), .groups="drop") %>%
  unnest_wider(Scores)

# Identification du Meilleur Match (Celui qui a le R max)
matches_s1 <- scores_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Cluster_Kmeans, names_to = "Shape", values_to = "R") %>%
  group_by(Cluster_Kmeans) %>%
  slice_max(R, n=1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% # Prend le max
  rename(Best_Shape = Shape) %>%
  select(Cluster_Kmeans, Best_Shape)

# Génération des courbes théoriques haute résolution
grid_z_fine <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 100)
shapes_fine <- get_shapes_lib(grid_z_fine)
scale_factor <- length(grid_z_fine) / 10 

df_s1_theory <- data.frame()

for(i in 1:nrow(matches_s1)) {
  s_name <- matches_s1$Best_Shape[i]
  c_name <- matches_s1$Cluster_Kmeans[i]
  
  # Récupération et Normalisation pour affichage visuel
  lad_raw <- shapes_fine[[s_name]]
  lad <- (lad_raw / sum(lad_raw)) * scale_factor
  
  df_s1_theory <- bind_rows(df_s1_theory, 
                            data.frame(Z=grid_z_fine, LAD=lad, 
                                       Cluster_Kmeans=c_name, 
                                       Shape_Name=s_name))
}

p_profiles <- ggplot() +
  geom_path(data=df_s1_real, aes(x=LAD, y=Z), color="black", size=1.5) +
  geom_path(data=df_s1_theory, aes(x=LAD, y=Z), color="red", linetype="dashed", size=1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Cluster_Kmeans, scales="free_x", nrow=1) +
  labs(subtitle = "A. Validation Visuelle (Noir : Réel / Rouge : Théorique)",
       x = "Densité (LAD)", y = "Hauteur Relative (Z)")

scores_long <- scores_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Cluster_Kmeans, names_to = "Theoretical_Shape", values_to = "R")

p_heatmap <- ggplot(scores_long, aes(x = Cluster_Kmeans, y = Theoretical_Shape, fill = R)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(R, 2)), color = "white", size = 3, fontface="bold") +
  # Echelle Standard : Jaune/Clair = Forte Corrélation (1)
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Pearson R") +
  labs(subtitle = "B. Qualité du Matching (Corrélation - Plus c'est clair, meilleur est le match)",
       x = "Cluster Réel (K-Means)", 
       y = "Forme Théorique") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face="bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

p_profiles / p_heatmap + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.2))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-s2-beta
#| fig-cap: "Figure S2 : Espace des Paramètres Bêta. Les points gris sont les arbres réels, les losanges colorés sont les formes théoriques."

# 1. Fit Beta sur les profils réels (Déciles)
fit_beta <- function(lad, z) {
  # Optimisation simple pour trouver alpha/beta
  fn <- function(p) sum((lad - dbeta(z, p[1], p[2])/sum(dbeta(z, p[1], p[2])))^2)
  opt <- try(optim(c(2,2), fn), silent=TRUE)
  if(inherits(opt, "try-error")) return(c(NA, NA))
  return(opt$par)
}

real_betas <- df_deciles %>%
  group_by(id_plot) %>%
  mutate(Z_mid = (as.numeric(Decile)-0.5)/10) %>%
  summarise(Params = list(fit_beta(LAD_Prop, Z_mid)), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(alpha = map_dbl(Params, 1), beta = map_dbl(Params, 2)) %>%
  filter(alpha > 0, beta > 0, alpha < 20, beta < 20) # Filtrage outliers

# 2. Paramètres Théoriques (Extraits de TA liste)
theo_betas <- data.frame(
  Label = c("Top-Heavy", "Bottom-Heavy", "Symmetric", "Low-Sym", "Extr-Bottom", "Top-Peak"),
  alpha = c(6,   2.5, 5, 3, 1.2, 15),
  beta  = c(2.5, 6,   5, 5, 15,  2)
)

# B. Cas Spécial : Uniforme (1, 1 par définition)
theo_betas <- rbind(theo_betas, data.frame(Label="Uniform", alpha=1, beta=1))

# C. Cas Spécial : Top-Bottom (Bimodal) -> On fit une beta "Effective"
# On génère le profil bimodal théorique
z_sim <- seq(0.01, 0.99, length.out=100)
lad_sim <- dbeta(z_sim, 4, 20) + dbeta(z_sim, 20, 5) # La formule du Top-Bottom
# On fit un alpha/beta unique dessus
tb_params <- fit_beta(lad_sim, z_sim)

theo_betas <- rbind(theo_betas, 
                    data.frame(Label="Top-Bottom", alpha=tb_params[1], beta=tb_params[2]))

# 3. Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data=real_betas, aes(x=alpha, y=beta), color="grey70", alpha=0.6, size=2) +
  geom_text_repel(data=real_betas, aes(x=alpha, y=beta, label=id_plot), 
                  size=3, color="grey40", max.overlaps = 100) +
  geom_point(data=theo_betas, aes(x=alpha, y=beta, color=Label), size=6, shape=18) +
  geom_text_repel(data=theo_betas, aes(x=alpha, y=beta, label=Label), 
                  box.padding = 0.6, fontface="bold") +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20)) + 
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option="turbo") +
  labs(title = "Figure S2 : Couverture de l'Espace des Paramètres",
       x = "Alpha (Concentration Haut)", y = "Beta (Concentration Bas)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
#| label: variance-partitioning-all
#| fig-cap: "Figure S6 : Hiérarchie des facteurs structurels pour l'ensemble des métriques microclimatiques."

# 1. Fonction Générique de Partitionnement
# Elle prend le nom de la variable réponse (y_col) et le nom pour l'affichage (label)
analyze_drivers <- function(data, y_col, label) {
  
  message(paste("Traitement de :", label, "..."))
  
  # Formule de base pour la météo (Effet aléatoire seul)
  f_weather <- as.formula(paste(y_col, "~ s(date_factor, bs='re')"))
  
  # Fonction R2 interne adaptée
  calc_r2 <- function(form) {
    # BAM avec SCAT (Robuste)
    m <- bam(form, data = data, family = scat(), method = "fREML", discrete = TRUE, nthreads = 4)
    # Ratio Variance Pred / Variance Obs
    var_pred <- var(predict(m, type = "response"), na.rm = TRUE)
    var_obs  <- var(data[[y_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    return(var_pred / var_obs)
  }
  
  # A. Calculs des R2
  r2_weather <- calc_r2(f_weather)
  
  # Formules pour chaque facteur (+ Météo)
  f_lai    <- as.formula(paste(y_col, "~ s(LAI_Scaled, k=5) + s(date_factor, bs='re')"))
  f_shape  <- as.formula(paste(y_col, "~ Shape + s(date_factor, bs='re')"))
  f_clump  <- as.formula(paste(y_col, "~ Clump_Scaled + s(date_factor, bs='re')"))
  f_height <- as.formula(paste(y_col, "~ Height_Scaled + s(date_factor, bs='re')"))
  
  # Modèle Total (pour info)
  f_total  <- as.formula(paste(y_col, "~ s(LAI_Scaled, k=5) + Shape + Clump_Scaled + Height_Scaled + s(date_factor, bs='re')"))
  
  # B. Exécution
  r2_lai_w    <- calc_r2(f_lai)
  r2_shape_w  <- calc_r2(f_shape)
  r2_clump_w  <- calc_r2(f_clump)
  r2_height_w <- calc_r2(f_height)
  r2_total    <- calc_r2(f_total)
  
  # C. Synthèse
  res <- data.frame(
    Metric = label,
    R2_Weather = r2_weather,
    R2_Total_Model = r2_total,
    Factor = c("LAI (Densité)", "Shape (Forme)", "Clumping (Continuité)", "Hauteur"),
    Variance_Added = c(
      max(0, r2_lai_w - r2_weather),
      max(0, r2_shape_w - r2_weather),
      max(0, r2_clump_w - r2_weather),
      max(0, r2_height_w - r2_weather)
    )
  )
  return(res)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Exécution pour les 4 variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------

# Lancement des calculs (peut prendre 2-3 minutes)
res_tmax  <- analyze_drivers(df_stats, "Delta_Tmax", "1. Refroidissement (Delta Tmax)")
res_tmin  <- analyze_drivers(df_stats, "Delta_Tmin", "2. Réchauffement Noc. (Delta Tmin)")
res_slope <- analyze_drivers(df_stats, "log_slope",  "3. Pouvoir Tampon (Log Slope)")
res_abs   <- analyze_drivers(df_stats, "T_Micro_Max","4. Température Absolue (Tmax Micro)")
res_min_abs <- analyze_drivers(df_stats, "T_Micro_Min", "5. Température Absolue (Tmin Micro)")

# Fusion
all_res <- bind_rows(res_tmax, res_tmin, res_slope, res_abs, res_min_abs)

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Visualisation Facettée
# -----------------------------------------------------------

# Création des labels complets pour les facettes (avec le R2 Météo inclus)
all_res <- all_res %>%
  mutate(Facet_Label = paste0(Metric, "\n(Météo seule : ", scales::percent(R2_Weather, 0.1), ")"))

ggplot(all_res, aes(x = reorder(Factor, Variance_Added), y = Variance_Added, fill = Factor)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Variance_Added, accuracy=0.1)), 
            hjust = -0.1, fontface = "bold", size = 3) +
  coord_flip() + # On tourne pour la lisibilité
  facet_wrap(~Facet_Label, scales = "free_x", ncol = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(title = "Figure S6 : Hiérarchie des Facteurs Structurels",
       subtitle = "Gain de variance expliquée par chaque facteur (au-delà de l'effet météo)",
       y = "Variance Ajoutée", 
       x = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
```
